## The Role of Hand-Crafted Templates
The system’s workflow begins with a small set of question templates that are hand-crafted based on the predicates in the KB ([document_1.txt](document_1.txt)).

Each template is associated with a predicate and consists of a transcription of the predicate in the KB (e.g., performsActivity ⇒ how to) and placeholders for the subject (#X#) and the object (#Y#) ([document_1.txt](document_1.txt)).
A seed question set is then generated by applying the templates on the KB ([document_1.txt](document_1.txt)).
For example, taking an in-house KB of the power tool domain, the template “how to use #X#” is first constructed for the predicate “performsActivity” ([document_1.txt](document_1.txt)).
The seed question “how to use jigsaw” is then generated by applying the template on the triple ⟨jigsaw, performsActivity, CurveCut⟩ ([document_1.txt](document_1.txt)).
